m: Marinate the chicken in oregano, lemon juice, half the garlic, a little oil and salt for 15 minutes.
Rinse and simmer the quinoa in 2 parts water for 12 minutes. Drain.
Tzatziki: grated cucumber (squeezed dry), yoghurt, the rest of the garlic, mint, lemon and salt.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken 5 to 6 minutes a side. Rest, then slice.
Salad: lettuce, chopped cucumber, tomatoes, red onion and crumbled fetta with lemon and a drizzle of oil.
Build bowls: quinoa, salad, chicken and tzatziki.
l: Built for lunch. Tzatziki on the side.
